research.title: Places in correspondence
research.description: Explore movement, plans, and geographic attention in three fictional letters.
research.provenance: Prepared teaching example: all letters and their dates are fictional. Relationships are editorial readings, not recorded AI output. City points are GeoNames coordinates rounded to two decimals, checked 29 October 2026.

records.quote: I am writing from Albuquerque, New Mexico.
records.title: Albuquerque, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5454711, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address.

records.quote: Yesterday I returned from Santa Fe, New Mexico, where I spent two days looking at buildings.
records.title: Santa Fe, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5490263, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address. Travel is reported in the fictional letter; no route is established.

records.quote: Tomorrow I hope to go on to Las Vegas, New Mexico, if the arrangements work out.
records.title: Las Vegas, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5475433, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address. State is explicit; this is a plan, not proof of arrival.

records.quote: I am writing from Gallup, New Mexico.
records.title: Gallup, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5468773, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address.

records.quote: Your postcards from Paris, France, are on the table beside me.
records.title: Paris, France
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 2988507, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address. The postcards connect the writer to Paris; this does not place the writer there.

records.quote: I have never been to Paris, but the pictures make me want to see it.
records.title: Paris, France
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 2988507, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address. Paris, France, supplied by the previous sentence; not visited is explicit.

records.quote: I am back in Albuquerque, New Mexico.
records.title: Albuquerque, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5454711, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address.

records.quote: Your last letter says only Springfield; which state should I put on the envelope?
records.title: Springfield (unresolved)
records.location_note: State and place identity unresolved. No location selected.

records.quote: I keep thinking about the buildings in Santa Fe, New Mexico.
records.title: Santa Fe, New Mexico
records.location_note: City point from GeoNames 5490263, rounded to two decimals (about 1 km). Not a historical address. A recollection, not another documented visit.

records.quote: I may return there next month, but I have made no arrangements.
records.title: “there” (unresolved reference)
records.location_note: Likely refers to Santa Fe in the previous sentence. Left unlocated to make this interpretive decision visible.

monuments.title: Remembering World War I
monuments.description: Browse two memorials in Washington, DC, through three photographs and their sources.
monuments.provenance: Prepared teaching collection, not a survey. Historical summaries and photo credits checked against linked NPS pages on 28 October 2026. Points are approximate site locations; do not use them for navigation. Unknown dates and inscriptions remain blank.

records.title: District of Columbia War Memorial
records.description: A memorial to District of Columbia residents who died in service during World War I. Its circular pavilion was also intended for musical performances.
records.source_label: National Park Service: District of Columbia War Memorial
records.location_note: Approximate site point south of the Reflecting Pool, supplied for this teaching map. Not a surveyed or independently verified coordinate.

records.title: World War I Memorial
records.description: A national memorial in Washington, DC, commemorating American service in World War I. This sample includes views of the Pershing statue and the Belvedere.
records.source_label: National Park Service: World War I Memorial
records.location_note: Approximate site point at Pershing Park, supplied for this teaching map. Not a surveyed or independently verified coordinate.
